dynamic_fee_applied.meaning: the dynamically calculated fee from DynamicSwapFeeModule.getFee() is actually applied by CLFactory.getSwapFee() rather than falling back to basic tick spacing fees

fallback_to_basic_tick_spacing_fee.meaning: CLFactory.getSwapFee() falls back to the basic tick spacing fee instead of applying the dynamically calculated fee

conflicting_fee_caps_present.meaning: conflicting fee caps exist between DynamicSwapFeeModule.getFee() (allows up to 500,000) and CLFactory.getSwapFee() (rejects above 100,000)

dynamic_fee_mechanism_ineffective_observ.meaning: the dynamic fee mechanism is rendered ineffective because the conflicting fee caps cause fallback to basic tick spacing fees

assumptions: The dynamic fee mechanism is expected to apply dynamically calculated fees rather than always falling back to basic tick spacing fees.

unresolved.description: The intent states the dynamic fee mechanism should remain effective, but the report does not give a concrete numeric dynamic fee value or a directly comparable quantity; the effectiveness relation is represented as a grounded Boolean rather than a numeric relation.

limitations: The intent's effectiveness requirement is qualitative; no numeric dynamic fee value above the factory cap is specified in the selected sources.
The impact's conflicting-cap mechanism is described in relation_context but is not part of the frozen P/I/V sources and is not encoded as a condition.
